sections.title: What makes a clinic website actually convert

items.title: Your website is your best receptionist — train it like one
items.body:
A great receptionist doesn’t just look presentable; she answers the price question before it’s asked, mentions this month’s offer, reassures the nervous first-timer, and closes the booking. A converting website does exactly that — in scroll order.

That’s why every Glowth treatment page follows the buyer’s actual sequence: what is it, does it work (proof), does it hurt, what does it cost, who does it, when can I come — and a booking path at every step for whoever’s ready early.

sections.title: Website development services — questions owners ask, answered straight

items.title: How much does a salon website cost in the UAE?
items.text: Professional builds typically run AED 5,000–25,000 depending on pages, booking integration and content; single landing pages cost far less. We quote fixed after a short scoping call — no hourly surprise

items.title: WordPress, Shopify or custom — what do you build on?
items.text: WordPress for most salon & clinic sites (you own it, anyone can maintain it), Shopify when retail products matter, custom when performance demands it. The platform serves the goal, never the other way round.

items.title: Can you redesign without losing my Google rankings?
items.text: Yes — migrations run with full URL mapping and redirects, so earned rankings transfer. Done right, rankings usually improve post-launch because speed and structure improve.

items.title: What actually makes visitors book?
items.text: Speed, prices, proof and a low-friction path — in that order. Clients bounce from slow sites, distrust hidden pricing, need reviews at the decision moment, and book where WhatsApp is one tap away.

items.title: Do I need a website if my Instagram is strong?
items.text: Instagram rents you the audience; the website converts and owns it. Google searches, ad clicks and AI recommendations all land somewhere — the businesses capturing them have a fast site with booking built in.

items.title: Who writes the content?
items.text: Our in-house beauty content specialists do — compliance-aware copy built on the same keyword map used in our SEO services, so every page earns search traffic as well as converting it. You review and approve everything.

sections.title: Salon & clinic website development services — before you ask

items.q: How long does the build take?
items.a: 3–4 weeks for a full site including copy, design, build, booking integration and the speed pass; single landing pages in about a week.

items.q: Will I be able to edit it myself?
items.a: Yes — prices, offers, photos and posts are editable without touching code, and we hand over with a short training video for your team.
We set up fast, UAE-appropriate hosting with a reliable provider, in your name (you own everything), and can manage it for you — or hand it to your IT contact.

items.q: Do you migrate my existing content and rankings?
items.a: Yes — full content migration with URL redirects so earned Google rankings carry over rather than reset.
The architecture ships Arabic-ready; the Arabic content layer can be added as your phase two without rebuilding anything.

items.q: What if I just need one landing page?
items.a: Perfect — landing pages are a standalone service, often the fastest ROI in this whole catalogue when ads are already running.
